title: Thumbnail renderer
body:
# Thumbnail renderer

## Profile
The renderer profile sets `thumb_width` to 256 pixels for every thumbnail. A 512-pixel variant was measured and dropped before release because it doubled storage per image.

title: Thumbnails render at a fixed width
body:
# Thumbnails render at a fixed width

## Context
The gallery shows many images per page and loads them over mobile links.

## Decision
Every thumbnail renders 256 pixels wide, the width set in the renderer profile (`area/thumbnail-renderer`).

## Consequences
Gallery pages stay light. A larger preview needs the full image.
